label: Summarize paper
description: Run a dedicated, isolated summary writer for one ready paper and wait for its saved version. Use only when the user requests a saved summary or explicit review requires a missing summary; discussing, explaining, or analyzing an existing summary never implies regeneration. Missing/incomplete summaries alone do not authorize writing, including in Deep Work. Use this writer rather than a general research worker. Jobs are queued and run sequentially, including multiple requests in one turn; they are not rejected for arriving together. The runtime selects the parent run's provider and model and disables summary reasoning where supported; these settings are not tool arguments. Check each saved-version receipt before claiming that paper is summarized. If recovered_saved_version is true, disclose that a verified artifact was recovered from the failed or cancelled summary_run_status, retaining its summary_run_error; do not claim the run completed. A partial or overview receipt does not satisfy explicit review; source reads and paper notes are separately required in review.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact ID of one already ingested local paper.
parameter_descriptions.mode: reviewed for a citation-grounded full review; overview only when the user requests a quick, explicitly limited orientation.
